text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once again, happy birthday, Bamboo.<n>Did you
enjoy the celebrations?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I admit, I was caught<n>pretty off guard
when you said we<n>were gonna hold a birthday
cake-eating competition...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But that charged atmosphere was<n>unbelievable! My
palms are still<n>sweating!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And even though I ended up losing, I<n>had so, so, SO
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad... It's your birthday, so I<n>wanted you to
have as much fun as<n>possible.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...! Don't tell me... did you plan<n>another competition
because I told<n>you how much fun I had racing you?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I also had fun back then... so I<n>was really
happy to hear you say<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest gratitude for such a<n>grand celebration!
Not only was it<n>tasty, but you gave me the best gift
of<n>all—red-hot competition!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I was thinking... Wanna go for a<n>post-meal
run to burn off those<n>calories?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure, I don't mind... as long as you<n>don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Right back at ya! This time, I won't<n>lose!
